nodes.label: Objekto Kortelė (Site Card) Design Concept
nodes.rationale: Standalone HTML idea mockup for the admin site-detail card: dark sidebar layout with tabs 'Objekto info', 'Įranga' (equipment table with category badges for inverter/modules/BESS/cables/mounting), 'Stringavimas' (string layout dark box + upload area), 'Failai & vizualizacijos', and 'Checklist'.
